repository.name: @webex/plugin-device-manager
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.devicemanager that manages the user's Webex room devices and Lyra spaces: refresh lists the recent auxiliary devices from WDM (devices/auxiliary) into a module-level collection that getAll reads, upsert and remove add and delete WDM entries, search finds devices through the directory search plugin, get resolves the Lyra endpoint for an ultrasound token, requestPin and pair run a Lyra PIN challenge and record the paired device on the instance, bindSpace and unbindSpace bind a conversation to the paired device, getAudioState and the mute and volume methods call the Lyra device API for the paired device and reject without one, while putAudioState passes the caller's space and audio state to Lyra with no pairing guard. A Mercury lyra.space_updated listener drops a pairing Lyra no longer verifies. User-assigned device names are decrypted through the encryption plugin. Argument and pairing guards log and reject with DeviceManager#method messages; Lyra, search, and WDM failures are logged and rejected, except that audio failures reject unlogged, refresh logs and resolves undefined, and the Mercury handler logs and resolves; a failed name decryption logs and yields undefined; nothing is persisted.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-device-manager package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers DeviceManager as public plugin 'devicemanager' with config {}; src/device-manager.js also imports the Lyra and search plugins. The first registration of the name wins. The entry exports the default DeviceManager and the named config.

public_interfaces.name: webex.devicemanager methods
public_interfaces.notes: getAll returns an array synchronously; refresh resolves the device array, or undefined after any failure; binding and audio methods except putAudioState reject without a paired device; upsert always moves the pending PIN device to paired; guards reject with an Error whose message starts with DeviceManager#method.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call Lyra, search, or KMS endpoints directly; go through webex.internal.lyra, webex.internal.search, and webex.internal.encryption.
negative_guidance.why: Those plugins own the URLs, request bodies, and KMS wrapping.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change when upsert sets the paired device without a change request.
negative_guidance.why: pair relies on upsert moving the pending PIN device to paired (INV-003).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not make the device list per instance or reset it outside refresh without a change request.
negative_guidance.why: getAll and the Mercury handler read the shared module-level list (INV-004).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not pass absolute space URLs to join, leave, or the bindings.
negative_guidance.why: Lyra sends them as catalog resources and needs the relative form (INV-005).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log PINs, decrypted device names, KMS key URLs, ultrasound tokens, or search queries through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users and grant access; the plugin logs only messages, error objects, and one device id today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its samples command, connect snippet, and chained flow do not run; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.

high.expectation: Source and a unit case agree, as for getPairedDevice and the paired-method accessors.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, as for every other method today. Pin current behavior with a unit case before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source, tests, nor a dependency's spec or code settles the question, as for why upsert changes pairing or why uc-cloud ids get the WDM URL. Stop and report the gap.
